items.q: What’s the age requirement for cannabis delivery in New Jersey?
items.a_html: New Jersey adult-use cannabis law sets the minimum age at 21. Age is verified when you create your Lady L account, and your driver will check your ID again at the door before completing the handoff. No exceptions can be made.

items.q: What forms of ID does Lady L accept for delivery?
items.a_html: Any valid, government-issued photo ID is accepted, including driver's licenses, state-issued IDs, and passports. Out-of-state IDs are welcome. You’ll need to upload your ID to your Lady L account before placing your first order and have the physical ID on hand when your driver arrives.

items.q: Do I need a medical cannabis card to order for delivery?
items.a_html: No, you don’t need a medical card at Lady L. We’re an adult-use dispensary, open to any customer 21 or older. A confirmed Lady L account and a valid ID are the only things you need to get started.

items.q: How much cannabis can I order?
items.a_html:
New Jersey law allows us to sell up to the equivalent of 28.35 grams, or one ounce, of usable cannabis per transaction. That total can include any combination of the following:

  • Dried Flower/Bud: 28.35 grams (1 ounce).
  • Concentrates/Resin/Oils: 4 grams (solid or liquid/vaporized oil).
  • Ingestible Items (Gummies/Edibles): 1,000 mg of THC (roughly ten 100mg packages).
  • Maximum Possession Limit: Up to 6 ounces of cannabis and cannabis products.
  • Mixing Products: You can mix and match, for example, by purchasing 1/2 ounce of flower and 2 grams of concentrates.
  • Daily Limits: The 1-ounce limit is generally considered a daily limit across all dispensaries.

items.q: What taxes come with East Rutherford weed delivery orders?
items.a_html: New Jersey adult-use cannabis purchases include a 6.625% state sales tax, a 2% municipal transfer or user tax, where applicable, and a $ 2.50-per-ounce Social Equity Excise Fee (SEEF). All of these apply equally to delivery orders, and every applicable charge is itemized at checkout before you confirm.
